summary_en: The video features a physics review session on atomic nuclei led by an instructor in a studio, intertwined with an introduction to the facilities, student activities, and admissions of the Saigon International University (SIU). The lecture covers nuclear structure, nuclear forces, radioactivity, radioactive decay laws, nuclear fission, nuclear fusion, and guided problem-solving.
